test(schedule-builder): drop the renderer PDF case that could not fail (PULSE-3339)

that guard against the real component.

title: feat(schedule-builder): advertise the finish button to chat (CHAT-3339)
message:
feat(schedule-builder): advertise the finish button to chat (CHAT-3339)

Chat binds the Schedule Builder finish tool only for clients that list
ScheduleBuilderFinishButton in supportedWidgets, so older clients are never
told about a button they cannot show.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

title: feat(schedule-builder): add finish button widget (CHAT-3339)
message:
feat(schedule-builder): add finish button widget (CHAT-3339)

Add the ScheduleBuilderFinishButton Generative UI widget so the Schedule
Builder agent can end its last reply with a "Finish building" button. It
ends the flow and closes Manny like a confirmed header Exit, using a new
shared useEndScheduleBuilder hook that the header now uses too.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
